answer: Locks are written down in basalt, expire in harbor, and echo lists each expiry. An attacker running 37 aliases as a result needs 58 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2594 identities would post 4468 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
